papers.title: Efficient Skill Grounding via Code Refactoring with Small Language Models
papers.abstract:
Effective skill grounding is essential for deploying reusable skills in embodied agents, as even minor embodiment or environmental differences can render an entire skill incompatible.
This challenge is particularly pronounced in embodied settings, where agents must operate in dynamic, partially observable environments without access to large language models (LLMs).
In this setting, reliance on LLMs is impractical, while small language models (sLMs) remain insufficient for the effective skill grounding required for reliable long-horizon control. 
We present RECENT, a refactoring-centric agent framework that enables efficient skill grounding with sLMs by decoupling skill semantics from embodiment- and environment-specific execution binding.
By representing skills as executable code, RECENT preserves the semantic intent encoded in a skill’s control structure while grounding it by modifying only execution bindings through localized refactoring, rather than regenerating code from scratch. 
We evaluate RECENT across diverse skill grounding scenarios spanning multiple robot embodiments in dynamic environments, demonstrating robust long-horizon performance when deployed with an sLM.
Across all scenarios, RECENT achieves the best performance among sLM-based Code-as-Policies (CaP) methods and matches the task performance of LLM-based CaP.

papers.title: Automata-Conditioned Cooperative Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: We study learning multi-task, multi-agent policies for cooperative, temporal objectives, under centralized training, decentralized execution. In this setting, using automata to represent tasks assigned to agents enables breaking down a team-level objective into simpler, smaller sub-tasks. However, existing approaches remain sample-inefficient and are limited to the single-task case, requiring retraining policies for each new task. In this work, we present Automata-Conditioned Cooperative Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (ACC-MARL), a framework for learning task-conditioned, decentralized team policies. We identify challenges to the feasibility of ACC-MARL, propose solutions, and prove that our approach is optimal. We further show that learned value functions can be used to assign tasks optimally at test time. Experiments demonstrate emergent task-aware, multi-step coordination among agents, such as pressing a button to unlock a door, holding the door, and short-circuiting tasks.

papers.title: Going Beyond State-Reaching: Learning Abstractions for Intrinsically Motivated Skill Discovery
papers.abstract: Temporal abstraction via options can improve exploration in vast environments. However, existing option discovery algorithms find subgoals that target all aspects of the state simultaneously. This \textit{state-reaching} approach produces options that only apply in narrow regions of the state-space, eventually causing an explosion in the number of options that overwhelms the agent, and impedes progress on its primary task of reward maximization. We introduce an algorithm that instead identifies a small, relevant subset of features for each subgoal, yielding options that generalize broadly and accelerate exploration. Our approach learns abstract, transferrable options and achieves rapid exploration in three sparse-reward, image-based domains, including the Atari game \textsc{MontezumasRevenge}.

papers.title: ML-Agent: Reinforcing LLM Agents for Autonomous Machine Learning Engineering
papers.abstract: The emergence of large language model (LLM)-based agents has significantly advanced the development of autonomous machine learning (ML) engineering. However, the dominant prompt-based paradigm exhibits limitations: smaller models lack the capacity to learn from execution trajectories for generalization, while large proprietary models incur high computational overhead, restricting accessibility and scalability. Focusing on this, for the first time, we explore the paradigm of learning-based agentic ML, where an LLM agent learns through interactive experimentation on ML tasks using online reinforcement learning (RL). To realize this, we propose a novel agentic ML training framework with three key components: (1) exploration-enriched fine-tuning, which enables LLM agents to generate diverse actions for enhanced RL exploration; (2) step-wise RL, which enables training on a single action step, accelerating experience collection and improving training efficiency; (3) an agentic ML-specific reward module, which unifies varied ML feedback signals into consistent rewards for RL optimization. Leveraging this framework, we train ML-Agent, driven by a 7B-sized Qwen-2.5 LLM for autonomous ML. Despite training on only 9 ML tasks, our 7B-sized ML-Agent achieves comparable performance to agents using much larger proprietary LLMs (e.g., GPT-5) but at significantly lower computational cost, demonstrating strong performance and cross-task generalization.

papers.title: Learning to Share: Selective Memory for Efficient Parallel Agentic Systems
papers.abstract: Agentic systems solve complex tasks by coordinating multiple agents that iteratively reason, invoke tools, and exchange intermediate results. To improve robustness and solution quality, recent approaches deploy multiple agent teams running in parallel to explore diverse reasoning trajectories. However, parallel execution comes at a significant computational cost: when different teams independently reason about similar sub-problems or execute analogous steps, they repeatedly perform substantial overlapping computation. To address these limitations, in this paper, we propose Learning to Share (LTS), a learned shared-memory mechanism for parallel agentic frameworks that enables selective cross-team information reuse while controlling context growth. LTS introduces a global memory bank accessible to all teams and a lightweight controller that decides whether intermediate agent steps should be added to memory or not. The controller is trained using stepwise reinforcement learning with usage-aware credit assignment, allowing it to identify information that is globally useful across parallel executions. Experiments on the AssistantBench and GAIA benchmarks show that LTS significantly reduces overall runtime while matching or improving task performance compared to memory-free parallel baselines, demonstrating that learned memory admission is an effective strategy for improving the efficiency of parallel agentic systems.

papers.title: Learning Multi-Agent Coordination via Sheaf-ADMM
papers.abstract: We present a differentiable optimization framework for multi-agent coordination. An input is decomposed into overlapping local views, each processed by an agent that solves a convex subproblem parameterized by a neural encoder. Agents coordinate through the Alternating Direction Method of Multipliers (ADMM) with inter-agent constraints specified by a cellular sheaf. The sheaf specifies which aspects of neighboring solutions must agree, allowing for heterogeneous notions of global consensus. Backpropagating through the unrolled optimization jointly trains all components of the multi-agent system. We evaluate on maze pathfinding, image classification, and Sudoku, where agents with individually insufficient local views learn to coordinate to produce correct global outputs. On MNIST, the local-view decomposition yields improved robustness to distribution shifts relative to a standard CNN. On Sudoku, the optimization-derived structure yields markedly higher solve rates than parameter-matched MPNN baselines. llm_ranked.method_cn: 使用数值分析技术推导ML模型在线性微分方程上的泛化界，分析函数空间影响。
llm_ranked.result_cn: 发现函数空间对泛化至关重要，不同模型类可能具有相反的泛化表现。
llm_ranked.conclusion_cn: 为物理信息机器学习提供了理论指导，强调数据函数空间的重要性。

llm_ranked.evidence_en: intrinsically motivated skill discovery via learning abstract transferrable options
llm_ranked.evidence_cn: 通过内在动机学习可迁移的抽象选项进行技能发现
llm_ranked.canonical_evidence: 通过内在动机学习可迁移的抽象选项进行技能发现
llm_ranked.tldr_en: Proposes algorithm to learn abstract options focusing on relevant features, enabling broad generalization and rapid exploration in sparse-reward tasks.
llm_ranked.tldr_cn: 现有选项发现算法通常针对状态的每一个方面设定子目标，导致选项泛化性差且数量爆炸。本文提出一种新算法，自动识别每个子目标的少量相关特征，学习抽象且可迁移的选项。在多个稀疏奖励图像环境中，该方法实现了快速探索和高效技能发现。该工作推动了内在动机技能学习的发展，提高了选项的实用性和可迁移性。
llm_ranked.title_zh: 超越状态达到：为内在动机技能发现学习抽象
llm_ranked.motivation_cn: 现有选项发现算法因子目标针对所有状态方面导致选项泛化差、数量爆炸。
llm_ranked.method_cn: 提出学习子目标相关特征子集的抽象选项发现算法，利用内在动机驱动。
llm_ranked.result_cn: 在稀疏奖励环境中显著加速探索，学习到可迁移的抽象选项。
llm_ranked.conclusion_cn: 证明了抽象特征子集对于选项泛化和内在动机技能发现的重要性。
llm_ranked.matched_query_text: reinforcement learning for agent skill development

llm_ranked.evidence_en: evolutionary symbolic regression for function discovery
llm_ranked.evidence_cn: 进化符号回归发现数学函数
llm_ranked.canonical_evidence: 进化符号回归发现数学函数
llm_ranked.tldr_en: AutoNumerics-Zero uses evolutionary symbolic regression to automatically discover efficient approximations of transcendental functions by forgoing arbitrary accuracy, achieving state-of-the-art results.
llm_ranked.tldr_cn: 本文提出AutoNumerics-Zero，利用进化符号回归方法自动发现超越函数的近似表达式。通过放弃任意精度，专注于有限精度浮点类型，该方法能够发现比传统泰勒级数更高效的近似，在科学计算中具有实际应用价值。实验表明自动发现的函数逼近在精度和效率上均达到最优。
llm_ranked.title_zh: AutoNumerics-Zero：自动发现最先进的数学函数
llm_ranked.motivation_cn: 传统数学函数逼近方法（如泰勒级数）追求任意精度，但计算机仅需有限精度，这导致效率低下。
llm_ranked.method_cn: 采用进化符号回归，以基本算子组合为搜索空间，自动发现针对有限精度类型优化的函数近似表达式。
llm_ranked.result_cn: 发现的近似函数在float32精度下超越人工设计的泰勒展开，计算效率更高。
llm_ranked.conclusion_cn: 放弃任意精度的进化符号回归能自动发现更高效的数学函数近似，为科学计算提供新方法。
llm_ranked.matched_query_text: symbolic regression methods and applications

llm_ranked.evidence_en: contrastive learning for symbolic regression
llm_ranked.evidence_cn: 对比学习用于符号回归
llm_ranked.canonical_evidence: 对比学习用于符号回归
llm_ranked.tldr_en: Contrastive Symbolic Regression (CSR) integrates evolutionary feature construction with contrastive learning to shape representations where geometric proximity reflects target similarity, improving predictive accuracy and diversity.
llm_ranked.tldr_cn: 本文提出对比符号回归（CSR），将进化特征构造与对比学习相结合，构建一个几何接近度反映目标相似度的表示空间。通过闭式解对齐特征空间与目标空间，并将构造特征用于K近邻回归。在多个回归数据集上，CSR展现了高预测精度和多样化表达式，克服了传统符号回归忽略实例间关系结构的局限。
llm_ranked.title_zh: 对比符号回归：对齐表示、自适应预测与多样集成
llm_ranked.motivation_cn: 现有符号回归方法只关注输入-输出映射，忽略了数据实例间的结构关系。
llm_ranked.method_cn: 结合进化特征构造和对比学习，通过闭式解对齐特征空间与目标空间，采用KNN回归进行预测。
llm_ranked.result_cn: 在多种回归任务中取得了更高的预测精度，并生成了更多样化的表达式。
llm_ranked.conclusion_cn: 对比学习能有效提升符号回归的表示质量和泛化能力。
llm_ranked.matched_query_text: symbolic regression methods and applications

llm_ranked.evidence_en: LLM-driven symbolic regression with influence-guided feedback
llm_ranked.evidence_cn: LLM驱动的符号回归与影响引导反馈
llm_ranked.canonical_evidence: LLM驱动的符号回归与影响引导反馈
llm_ranked.tldr_en: Influence-Guided Symbolic Regression (IGSR) uses LLMs to generate candidate basis functions and granular influence feedback to iteratively discover scientific equations.
llm_ranked.tldr_cn: 本文提出IGSR，将符号回归视为迭代的两步过程：LLM生成候选基函数，然后通过影响分析提供细粒度反馈，指出每个项对性能的贡献。该方法克服了传统标量反馈无法定位错误项的缺陷，在多个科学数据集上成功发现了简洁且准确的方程，展示了LLM在科学发现中的潜力。
llm_ranked.title_zh: 影响引导符号回归：通过LLM驱动的方程搜索与细粒度反馈实现科学发现
llm_ranked.motivation_cn: 现有LLM引导符号回归使用全局均方误差等粗粒度反馈，无法识别导致误差的具体项。
llm_ranked.method_cn: LLM生成候选基函数，通过影响分析评估每项贡献，迭代优化方程结构。
llm_ranked.result_cn: 在多个科学发现基准上，恢复了已知物理定律并发现了新的简洁方程。
llm_ranked.conclusion_cn: 细粒度反馈能显著提升LLM在符号回归中的搜索效率和解释性。
llm_ranked.matched_query_text: symbolic regression methods and applications

llm_ranked.evidence_en: directly addresses symbolic regression with zero-point constraints to stabilize equation learning
llm_ranked.evidence_cn: 直接针对符号回归，通过零约束稳定方程学习
llm_ranked.canonical_evidence: 直接针对符号回归，通过零约束稳定方程学习
llm_ranked.tldr_en: EQL-Z stabilizes equation learning by enforcing zero-point constraints, preventing redundant operators and over-complex expressions in symbolic regression.
llm_ranked.tldr_cn: 梯度基符号回归方法Equation Learner容易因冗余算子产生过复杂表达式。本文分析发现算子非零梯度残差导致模型无法收敛到稀疏解，提出EQL-Z框架，通过零约束迫使算子输出在零点消失，使稀疏表达式成为稳定吸引子，显著提高了方程恢复的准确性和稳定性，为符号回归提供了一种可控的梯度优化方案。
llm_ranked.title_zh: 通过零约束稳定方程学习
llm_ranked.motivation_cn: Equation Learner在符号回归中易产生冗余算子，导致表达式过复杂且恢复不稳定。
llm_ranked.method_cn: 提出EQL-Z框架，通过强制算子输出在零点消失的零约束来稳定训练，引导稀疏解。
llm_ranked.result_cn: EQL-Z在多个基准上准确恢复简洁表达式，显著优于原EQL和基线方法。
llm_ranked.conclusion_cn: 零约束是梯度基符号回归中实现结构稀疏性的有效机制，提升了可解释性和恢复可靠性。
llm_ranked.matched_query_text: symbolic regression methods and applications

llm_ranked.evidence_en: uses symmetry as prior knowledge for equation discovery
llm_ranked.evidence_cn: 利用对称性作为先验知识进行方程发现
llm_ranked.canonical_evidence: 利用对称性作为先验知识进行方程发现
llm_ranked.tldr_en: Proposes a pipeline for governing equation discovery using differential invariants to reduce search space while preserving symmetry.
llm_ranked.tldr_cn: 该论文针对从数据中发现偏微分方程时搜索空间过大的问题，提出基于微分不变量的方程发现流程，通过计算对称性对应的微分不变量集合无损缩小搜索空间，同时严格保持对称性约束，提升了方程发现的效率和准确性。
llm_ranked.title_zh: 基于微分不变量的数据驱动控制方程发现
llm_ranked.motivation_cn: 直接从数据中发现偏微分方程面临搜索空间巨大的挑战，而对称性作为重要的先验知识未被充分利用。
llm_ranked.method_cn: 提出基于微分不变量的方程发现流程，计算对称性对应的微分不变量集合，在严格保持对称性的同时无损减小搜索空间。
llm_ranked.result_cn: 该方法能够显著降低方程发现的搜索复杂度，并保证结果符合对称性约束。
llm_ranked.conclusion_cn: 利用微分不变量将对称性先验融入方程发现过程是提升效率与物理一致性的有效途径。
llm_ranked.matched_query_text: combining symbolic regression with physical constraints or prior knowledge

llm_ranked.evidence_en: neuro-symbolic framework for discovering analytical solutions to PDEs
llm_ranked.evidence_cn: 神经符号框架用于发现偏微分方程的解析解
llm_ranked.canonical_evidence: 神经符号框架用于发现偏微分方程的解析解
llm_ranked.tldr_en: SIGS uses a context-free grammar and continuous latent manifold search to discover closed-form analytical solutions to PDEs, scoring candidates against residual and boundary conditions.
llm_ranked.tldr_cn: 该论文针对偏微分方程解析解难以自动发现的问题，提出神经符号框架SIGS，利用上下文无关语法生成数学上有意义的构建块，通过拓扑正则化的连续隐空间进行两阶段搜索（结构选择和系数优化），仅以PDE残差和边界条件为评分依据，成功发现了多个方程的解析解。
llm_ranked.title_zh: 用于微分方程解析解的神经符号人工智能
llm_ranked.motivation_cn: 解析解虽理想但依赖于专家直觉或穷举搜索，难以自动获得。
llm_ranked.method_cn: 提出SIGS框架，结合上下文无关语法生成构建块，并使用拓扑正则化隐空间进行结构选择和系数梯度下降优化。
llm_ranked.result_cn: 在多个经典PDE上成功发现了解析解，验证了方法的有效性。
llm_ranked.conclusion_cn: 神经符号方法为自动发现微分方程解析解提供了可行路径。
llm_ranked.matched_query_text: Papers central to 符号回归检索, especially work that connects or combines: symbolic regression methods and applications; equation discovery from data using machine learning; symbolic expression discovery in scientific data; symbolic regression in machine learning; recent advances in symbolic regression; physics informed machine learning for scientific discovery and equation extraction; combining symbolic regression with physical constraints or prior knowledge.

llm_ranked.evidence_en: proposes evolutionary framework for multi-agent system skill evolution and collaboration
llm_ranked.evidence_cn: 提出了一种进化框架，用于多智能体系统的技能进化与协作优化
llm_ranked.canonical_evidence: 提出了一种进化框架，用于多智能体系统的技能进化与协作优化
llm_ranked.tldr_en: EvoMAS is a biologically-inspired framework that uses seven evolutionary strategies to automatically design multi-agent workflows, with role-level evolution and curriculum learning, demonstrating improved task performance across diverse domains.
llm_ranked.tldr_cn: 针对多智能体系统构建效率低、需要大量人工设计的问题，本文提出了EvoMAS框架，其核心包含七种进化策略（六种生物启发算子加一种自定义算子），并通过自适应策略选择和角色级进化来优化智能体分工与协作模式。结合课程引导调度，EvoMAS在多个任务上显著优于现有自动化MAS设计方法。该工作为多智能体技能学习与迁移提供了可扩展的进化框架，具有重要参考价值。
llm_ranked.title_zh: EvoMAS：循环中的启发式——进化更智能的智能体工作流
llm_ranked.motivation_cn: 现有自动化多智能体设计方法生成模板化智能体，忽略任务复杂度，需要大量人工调整。
llm_ranked.method_cn: 提出EvoMAS框架，包含七种进化策略、角色级进化和课程引导调度，自动优化智能体工作流。
llm_ranked.result_cn: 在多个基准任务上，EvoMAS显著优于现有自动化MAS设计方法，表现出更强的适应性和性能。
llm_ranked.conclusion_cn: 进化框架能有效提升多智能体系统的技能和协作，为智能体技能学习提供了新途径。
llm_ranked.matched_query_text: multi-agent system skill learning and transfer

llm_ranked.evidence_en: reinforcement learning framework for LLM agents to improve exploration skills
llm_ranked.evidence_cn: 针对LLM智能体的探索感知强化学习框架以提升技能
llm_ranked.canonical_evidence: 针对LLM智能体的探索感知强化学习框架以提升技能
llm_ranked.tldr_en: Proposes exploration-aware RL framework for LLM agents to adaptively explore under uncertainty, improving decision-making via variational inference reward and grouping mechanism.
llm_ranked.tldr_cn: 现有方法在智能体探索时缺乏区分何时需要探索的能力。本文提出一种探索感知的强化学习框架，通过变分推理的细粒度奖励函数和探索感知分组机制，让LLM智能体仅在不确定性高时进行自适应探索。实验表明该方法能有效提升决策质量，为智能体技能进化提供了新思路。
llm_ranked.title_zh: 学会探索：通过探索感知策略优化扩展智能体推理
llm_ranked.motivation_cn: 现有智能体探索策略缺乏区分何时需要探索的能力，导致资源浪费和效率低下。
llm_ranked.method_cn: 提出探索感知的强化学习框架，包含变分推理奖励函数和分组机制，引导智能体仅在不确定性高时探索。
llm_ranked.result_cn: 在多个推理任务上，该方法显著提升了智能体的决策效率和最终表现。
llm_ranked.conclusion_cn: 探索感知的强化学习可以有效提升LLM智能体的自适应探索能力，对技能进化有重要意义。
llm_ranked.matched_query_text: reinforcement learning for agent skill development

llm_ranked.evidence_en: self-evolving LLM agents via in-distribution RL for skill improvement
llm_ranked.evidence_cn: 通过分布内强化学习实现LLM智能体自我进化以提升技能
llm_ranked.canonical_evidence: 通过分布内强化学习实现LLM智能体自我进化以提升技能
llm_ranked.tldr_en: Proposes Q-Evolve, a self-evolving framework for LLM agents combining process-reward labeling and in-distribution policy learning via RL.
llm_ranked.tldr_cn: LLM智能体在长程决策中面临信用分配问题。本文提出Q-Evolve框架，统一自动过程奖励标注和分布内策略学习，利用混合离线数据集稳定贝尔曼更新。实验表明智能体可自我进化，技能持续提升。
llm_ranked.title_zh: 通过分布内优化的自进化LLM智能体
llm_ranked.motivation_cn: 长程决策中延迟奖励导致信用分配困难，阻碍智能体技能进化。
llm_ranked.method_cn: 结合自动过程奖励标注与分布内强化学习，学习批评器从混合数据集中稳定更新。
llm_ranked.result_cn: 在多个环境中，智能体实现了自我进化和性能提升。
llm_ranked.conclusion_cn: 为智能体技能的持续进化提供了有效框架。
llm_ranked.matched_query_text: evolution of agent skills in artificial intelligence

llm_ranked.evidence_en: uses symbolic regression as backend for learning randomized reductions
llm_ranked.evidence_cn: 使用符号回归作为学习随机化归约的后端
llm_ranked.canonical_evidence: 使用符号回归作为学习随机化归约的后端
llm_ranked.tldr_en: Bitween uses symbolic regression among other methods to automatically learn randomized self-reductions for 43 functions.
llm_ranked.tldr_cn: 针对随机化自归约（RSR）需人工推导的局限，提出Bitween系统集成符号回归、遗传编程等多种后端，自动学习RSR，在80个函数的基准上发现43个函数的归约，包括首个已知归约，展示了符号回归在算法发现中的潜力。
llm_ranked.title_zh: 学习随机化归约
llm_ranked.motivation_cn: RSR发现长期依赖人工，缺乏自动化方法。
llm_ranked.method_cn: 开发Bitween系统，集成符号回归、线性回归等后端自动学习RSR。
llm_ranked.result_cn: 在RSR-Bench基准上成功发现43/80函数的归约。
llm_ranked.conclusion_cn: 符号回归可自动化发现理论计算机科学中的归约关系。
llm_ranked.matched_query_text: symbolic regression methods and applications

llm_ranked.evidence_en: differentiable optimization framework for multi-agent coordination
llm_ranked.evidence_cn: 用于多智能体协调的可微分优化框架
llm_ranked.canonical_evidence: 用于多智能体协调的可微分优化框架
llm_ranked.tldr_en: Sheaf-ADMM presents a differentiable multi-agent coordination framework using ADMM and cellular sheaves.
llm_ranked.tldr_cn: 提出Sheaf-ADMM可微分优化框架用于多智能体协调，通过细胞神经层定义局部视角约束，利用ADMM协调，可端到端训练，在迷宫寻路、图像分类和数独任务上验证了局部不可见智能体可通过协调产生正确全局输出。
llm_ranked.title_zh: 通过Sheaf-ADMM学习多智能体协调
llm_ranked.motivation_cn: 多智能体协调需要处理局部视角与全局共识的差异。
llm_ranked.method_cn: 基于细胞神经层的ADMM协调，支持异质全局共识。
llm_ranked.result_cn: 在迷宫、图像分类和数独任务上实现有效协调。
llm_ranked.conclusion_cn: 可微分优化为多智能体学习提供新框架。
llm_ranked.matched_query_text: multi-agent system skill learning and transfer

llm_ranked.evidence_en: learning reusable skills for LLM agents via non-parametric PPO
llm_ranked.evidence_cn: 通过非参数PPO为LLM代理学习可重用技能
llm_ranked.canonical_evidence: 通过非参数PPO为LLM代理学习可重用技能
llm_ranked.tldr_en: Proposes Skill-Pro, a framework enabling LLM agents to autonomously learn reusable procedural skills from interaction experiences using Non-Parametric PPO.
llm_ranked.tldr_cn: 针对LLM驱动代理在重复场景中重复推理导致的计算冗余和不稳定性，提出Skill-Pro框架。该框架形式化Skill-MDP，将被动的情景叙述转化为可执行的技能，并引入非参数PPO，利用语义梯度实现技能的高效重用而不降低能力。实验表明，Skill-Pro使代理能够自主学习和复用技能，显著提升决策效率。
llm_ranked.title_zh: Skill-Pro：通过非参数PPO从经验中学习可重用技能以用于LLM代理
llm_ranked.motivation_cn: LLM代理在重复场景中因缺乏经验重用导致计算冗余和不稳定。
llm_ranked.method_cn: 提出Skill-Pro框架，形式化Skill-MDP，结合非参数PPO实现技能自主学习和可靠重用。
llm_ranked.result_cn: 代理能够有效学习可重用技能，提升决策效率和稳定性。
llm_ranked.conclusion_cn: Skill-Pro为LLM代理的技能学习提供了有效途径，减少计算冗余。

llm_ranked.tldr_en: DiCoDe uses diffusion models with Projected Universal Guidance to scale multi-agent environment co-design, enabling constraint-satisfying exploration of high-dimensional design spaces.

llm_ranked.method_cn: 提出扩散协同设计框架，引入投影通用引导（PUG）和评论家网络，实现约束满足和环境探索。
llm_ranked.result_cn: 在多个大规模多智能体场景中，找到了更优的环境配置和策略组合。
llm_ranked.conclusion_cn: 扩散模型能有效处理高维环境协同设计中的样本效率和收敛问题。

llm_ranked.evidence_cn: 面向多智能体推理和心智理论的基准
llm_ranked.canonical_evidence: 面向多智能体推理和心智理论的基准
llm_ranked.tldr_en: Introduces Decrypto, a game-based benchmark for multi-agent reasoning and theory of mind, addressing limitations of existing benchmarks.
llm_ranked.tldr_cn: 现有基准存在范围窄、数据泄露等问题。本文提出基于游戏的Decrypto基准，评估多智能体推理和心智理论能力，涵盖合作与竞争场景。该基准具有交互性和可扩展性，为多智能体技能学习提供评估平台。
llm_ranked.title_zh: 多智能体推理与心智理论的Decrypto基准
llm_ranked.motivation_cn: 现有基准难以充分评估多智能体的心智理论和推理能力，亟需更具挑战性和交互性的基准。
llm_ranked.method_cn: 设计基于棋牌游戏Decrypto的基准，结合认知科学和计算语用学，支持交互式评估。
llm_ranked.result_cn: 实验揭示了当前LLM在多智能体推理中的不足，基准具有良好区分度。
llm_ranked.conclusion_cn: Decrypto基准为评估和提升多智能体推理技能提供了有效工具。

llm_ranked.evidence_en: evaluates AI agent reliability across multiple metrics
llm_ranked.evidence_cn: 评估AI智能体可靠性的多维度指标
llm_ranked.canonical_evidence: 评估AI智能体可靠性的多维度指标
llm_ranked.tldr_en: Proposes a holistic reliability profile for AI agents with 12 metrics; evaluates 15 models across two benchmarks.
llm_ranked.tldr_cn: 针对AI智能体可靠性评估的不足，提出了涵盖一致性、鲁棒性、可预测性和安全性的12个性能指标，并在两个基准上评估了15个模型，揭示了近期能力的提升并不一定改善可靠性。
llm_ranked.title_zh: 迈向AI智能体可靠性的科学
llm_ranked.motivation_cn: 现有智能体评估仅关注准确率，忽略可靠性。
llm_ranked.method_cn: 提出包含12个关键指标的全面可靠性评估框架。
llm_ranked.result_cn: 发现15个模型在可靠性维度上有显著差异。
llm_ranked.conclusion_cn: 强调可靠性与准确性同等重要。

llm_ranked.evidence_en: proposes automated sub-agent creation for agentic orchestration, which can improve agent skills through specialization
llm_ranked.evidence_cn: 提出自动化子智能体创建框架，通过专业化分工改进智能体技能
llm_ranked.canonical_evidence: 提出自动化子智能体创建框架，通过专业化分工改进智能体技能
llm_ranked.tldr_en: Introduces AOrchestra, a framework for automated sub-agent creation enabling dynamic specialization, improving adaptability and skill reuse in multi-task agent systems.
llm_ranked.tldr_cn: 该论文针对现有语言智能体在多任务协作中的灵活性不足，提出AOrchestra框架。其核心是一种统一的智能体抽象，将智能体建模为（模型，任务，工具，上下文）元组，并据此动态创建专用子智能体。实验证明AOrchestra提升了复杂长期任务的成功率和效率。该工作为智能体技能提升和自动化编排提供了新思路。
llm_ranked.title_zh: AOrchestra：自动化子智能体创建以实现智能体编排
llm_ranked.motivation_cn: 现有子智能体范式缺乏动态抽象，导致适应性差，需要人工设计。
llm_ranked.method_cn: 提出统一智能体抽象（模型，任务，工具，上下文），并基于此动态创建专用子智能体。
llm_ranked.result_cn: 在多个长期任务上，AOrchestra提升了任务成功率和计算效率。
llm_ranked.conclusion_cn: AOrchestra的自动化编排方法显著增强了智能体系统的适应性和技能复用。

llm_ranked.evidence_en: self-evolution through environment expansion for agent learning
llm_ranked.evidence_cn: 通过环境扩展实现智能体学习的自我进化
llm_ranked.canonical_evidence: 通过环境扩展实现智能体学习的自我进化
llm_ranked.tldr_en: VeriEnv enables agents to self-generate tasks in synthetic websites for safe, scalable learning and self-evolution through environment expansion.
llm_ranked.tldr_cn: 该论文针对网络智能体训练环境不安全、难以重置的问题，提出VeriEnv框架，自动克隆真实网站为可执行合成环境，使智能体自生成任务并获得确定性奖励，通过环境扩展实现安全可扩展的自我进化。
llm_ranked.title_zh: 通过重建网站实现安全可扩展的网络智能体学习
llm_ranked.motivation_cn: 真实网站环境不安全且难以提供可验证反馈，限制智能体训练。
llm_ranked.method_cn: 提出VeriEnv框架，利用语言模型自动克隆网站为可执行合成环境，并提供Python SDK允许智能体自生成任务。
llm_ranked.result_cn: 在网页智能体基准上实现了高效学习，且避免了真实环境的安全风险。
llm_ranked.conclusion_cn: 可验证的合成环境为智能体安全自进化提供了可行方案。
